cases.task: Choose the safe dashboard behavior when an active SSE stream emits an event or page whose lastEventId is missing, non-canonical, overflowing uint64, or regresses behind the accepted cursor.

required_facts.text: Continuing after an invalid or regressive frame ID makes the durable manual-resume cursor ambiguous.
The last accepted cursor must remain unchanged.
Callbacks already queued for the failed stream must not mutate the UI after the protocol failure.
